# Quaternius - Ultimate Animated Character Pack (Nov 2019)

- Author: Quaternius (https://quaternius.com)
- Pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html
- Downloaded from the official Google Drive folder linked on that page:
  https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1sNi1AfenfPRrvRt5yfaj5QMMd6KKcUJ5 (glTF folder)
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication), see LICENSE in this folder.

Files used (unmodified, in proto3d/models/people/):
Casual_Male, Casual_Female, Casual2_Male, Casual2_Female, Casual3_Male, Casual3_Female,
OldClassy_Male (.gltf, with their built-in animations).

In the game their materials are recoloured at runtime (skin tones and clothing colours
from the 2D game's palette), and some characters get a lappa and head wrap attached.
